title: Strict CSP without console errors on every page
goal: Every Operon page logs browser console errors caused by the backend's Content-Security-Policy: the Google Fonts stylesheet (fonts.googleapis.com) is refused, and an inline <script> in frontend/index.html is refused by script-src 'self'. Make every page load with zero console errors while keeping the CSP strict: never add 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval' to script-src. Move the inline script into a same-origin module (or remove it if it is redundant) and either self-host the fonts or allow exactly the needed origins (style-src fonts.googleapis.com, font-src fonts.gstatic.com). Add backend tests that check the CSP header forbids inline scripts and allows only the intended font origins, and that the built index.html contains no inline script.
constraints: Keep the CSP strict. Touch only CSP, index.html, the moved script and tests. All backend tests, frontend tests, typecheck, lint and build must pass.
